python3 - <<'PY'
from datetime import date
from pypdf import PdfWriter, PdfReader
from pypdf.generic import DictionaryObject, NameObject, StreamObject

# ---- Create cover page ----
writer = PdfWriter()
page = writer.add_blank_page(width=612, height=792)

helv = DictionaryObject()
helv[NameObject('/Type')] = NameObject('/Font')
helv[NameObject('/Subtype')] = NameObject('/Type1')
helv[NameObject('/BaseFont')] = NameObject('/Helvetica-Bold')
fonts = DictionaryObject()
fonts[NameObject('/F1')] = helv
resources = DictionaryObject()
resources[NameObject('/Font')] = fonts
page[NameObject('/Resources')] = resources

title = "Annual Financial Report"
today = date.today().strftime('%B %d, %Y')

def center_x(text, font_size):
    approx_width = 0.55 * font_size * len(text)
    return (612 - approx_width) / 2.0

content = "\n".join([
    "BT",
    "/F1 40 Tf",
    "%.2f %.2f Td" % (center_x(title, 40), 420),
    "(%s) Tj" % title,
    "/F1 20 Tf",
    "%.2f %.2f Td" % (center_x(today, 20) - center_x(title, 40), -70),
    "(%s) Tj" % today,
    "ET",
])

stream = StreamObject()
stream.set_data(content.encode('latin-1'))
page[NameObject('/Contents')] = writer._add_object(stream)

with open('cover.pdf', 'wb') as f:
    writer.write(f)

# ---- Merge cover + report ----
merged = PdfWriter()
merged.append('cover.pdf')
merged.append('report.pdf')
with open('report_with_cover.pdf', 'wb') as f:
    merged.write(f)

print('created cover.pdf and report_with_cover.pdf')
PY
